description: C2 fake catalog (docs/commercial-c2-design.md): make present-c2. As P1-a, but the contract is apa.pay.v2: each task starts with a BBS+ credential issued by the test issuer in --credential-dir (old BBS+, not W3C bbs-2023; synthetic test keys, no real identity), and each purchase is verified first (CREDENTIAL_VERIFIED) and decided with the result. Revoke a task's credential with apa-issuer revoke while its Ask waits: the approval then withdraws the session. Issuer, holder and verifier run in the host process: this shows the wiring, not independent parties. Fake CLI only, no model, no key, no transaction.
